record.what_it_does: iPayX is a FINTRAC-registered FX forensic audit API/MCP service that scores bank or card-network foreign-exchange rates against live mid-market rates to surface hidden markup and spread costs.
record.auth_notes: Production REST API and the full_forensic_report MCP tool require a static 'ipx_live_...' API key sent as 'Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key'. No OAuth2 flow is documented. Two public MCP tools (check_fx_rate, audit_transaction) require no auth at all, just per-IP rate limiting.
record.access_notes: Free plan gives 5 lifetime audits and an API key via self-signup, and the public MCP tools work with zero signup. However, the developers page also lists paid API tiers starting at 'Developer — $99/mo · 100 audits/mo' for sustained/production use, so meaningful volume requires a paid plan.
record.main_blocker: Very narrow, single-purpose API (FX audit only, 4 endpoints) with paid tiers gating real usage volume
